title: bwrk global first-run bootstrap
description: WHY: the global manager is an addon activated by command, not an install artifact - brew and npm users who never run install.sh must get the same onboarding. This behavior was originally scoped inside the install.sh task of the packaging sprint and moved here because it is CLI addon behavior, not install tooling. WHAT: any bwrk global subcommand (and bwrk capture, once it exists) executed when no global registry is present offers initialization interactively - one question, then bwrk global init creates the registry root and global workspace and continues the original command; in json mode return a typed error (BOREAL_INVALID_INPUT or a dedicated code) carrying the exact init command instead of prompting, so agents get a machine-actionable next step; re-running after init proceeds normally. Respect BOREAL_PROJECT_REGISTRY_ROOT overrides (packages/core/src/project-registry.ts) and reconcile with the existing silent auto-init for global contexts in createCliContext (apps/cli/src/context.ts lines 52-70) rather than adding a second bootstrap path: decide whether silent auto-init remains for explicit global flags while interactive bootstrap covers bare global subcommands, and record the resolution in the task closeout.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk global on a machine with no registry offers init interactively and completes the original command after acceptance
In json mode a typed error names the init command with no prompt
Behavior reconciled with existing global auto-init in createCliContext, decision recorded
